title: The big business of dorm decor with Urban Outfitters
description: This week on the Modern Retail podcast, Urban Outfitters' Karen Booker dives into the company's dorm room decor strategy.

title: In off price, Ross is the new boss
description: Store comps at the off-price retailer soared 10% in Q2, thanks to new and returning customers, in sharp contrast to major rival TJX Cos.

title: Roots to be acquired by Roberto Cavalli parent company
description: The outdoor retailer will go private in a deal led by Marquee Brands that is designed to ensure it “remains anchored in Canadian culture.”

title: Amazon plans drone delivery expansion to 5 more U.S. metro areas
description:
Amazon.com Inc. is expanding its Prime Air drone delivery to five more U.S. metro areas, the online retail giant announced Aug. 19. The fast-delivery service is slated to launch “soon” in the Chicago, Syracuse, Cleveland, Atlanta and Boise markets, with more communities to follow later this year, Amazon said in a blog post. title: Peec AI alternatives for AI visibility monitoring in 2026
description: Peec AI alternatives are AI visibility platforms that go beyond monitoring to help marketing teams close citation gaps, connect AI search data to CRM attribution, and run programs across multiple regions and content workflows.

title: Ann Taylor stages a brand comeback with Substack, fall fashion blitz
description: The brand’s first major integrated campaign in nearly a decade follows initiatives focused on fostering a fan community, such as an editorial newsletter.

title: Walmart finally starts supporting Apple Pay and Google Pay
description: By the end of this year, shoppers will finally be able to use Apple Pay and Google Pay in Walmart stores, ending years of frustration that the retailer didn't support what is now a nearly ubiquitous payment option.

description: Anthropic forbids its Claude models from generating sexually explicit content. But a series of tests conducted by TechCrunch found that it didn't take much to get past the restriction.

description: "The real challenge for merchants is not which rail a payment uses but a lack of visibility, control, and intelligence to optimize payment flows," a fintech marketing executive writes.
